sections.content: Studying the pre-Columbian world requires comparing sources and evidence. Formal connectors like a pesar de and a raíz de are useful for weighing evidence and drawing conclusions.

items.spanish: A pesar de las diferencias entre los pueblos, todos dejaron un legado que continúa presente.
items.english: Despite the differences between the peoples, all of them left a legacy that remains present.

items.spanish: A raíz de nuevos hallazgos arqueológicos, los historiadores revisan constantemente sus interpretaciones.
items.english: As a result of new archaeological findings, historians constantly revise their interpretations.

items.spanish: Una fuente aporta información, pero siempre debe compararse con otras evidencias.
items.english: A source provides information, but it must always be compared with other evidence.

sections.content: A pesar de and a raíz de let you weigh evidence and draw a conclusion — the kind of sentence a historian's argument is actually built from.
